gloss: to crush; to smash; to kill (time); to waste

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {潰|つぶ}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to crush; to smash; to squash
definitions.explanation: To press or squeeze something until it is flattened or destroyed.
To spend time in an idle or unproductive way.

definitions.gloss: to waste; to ruin; to spoil
definitions.explanation: To destroy the value or potential of something.

definitions.gloss: to shut down; to close (a business)
definitions.explanation: To cause a business or organization to fail.

examples.english: I crushed the empty can with my foot.

notes:
{潰|つぶ}す is transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). The intransitive pair is ⟦{潰|つぶ}れる→潰れる：04249_tsubureru⟧ (to be crushed, to collapse).

ASPECT (ている):
{潰|つぶ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing action of crushing, or a progressive state of wasting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潰|つぶ}す (to kill time)
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潰|つぶ}す (to shut down a shop)
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潰|つぶ}す (to make someone lose face)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潰|つぶ}す (to lose one's voice from overuse)
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{潰|つぶ}す: The object being crushed/wasted
- ～⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{潰|つぶ}す: The means of crushing

This verb is very versatile and appears in many idiomatic expressions.
